## You must change `src/`

This phase declares `must_touch: [src/]`. The gate fails the phase unless at
least one changed file falls under it. Writing tests, documentation or a report
is not enough — if you finish without touching that area, the phase fails on
exactly that check.


## Evidence — verified finding

```
phases/phase-041/.done exists and `git -C redblue log --oneline main --grep='phase-041 '` prints nothing. The work is sitting in the working tree: `git -C redblue status --porcelain` reports ` M src/parser.rs`, `A tests/text_split_join_test.rs`, `A phases/phase-041/REPORT.md`, `A phases/phase-041/FINDINGS.md`, and `git -C redblue diff --stat HEAD` totals 1800 insertions and 17 deletions, of which tests/text_split_join_test.rs is 1235 lines that no commit contains. The state store says the phase is complete, its REPORT describes a change that exists in no commit, and `cargo test` is green partly because 1235 lines of test code were never committed. The next `git checkout`, the next fresh CI clone, or the next phase that starts from a clean tree loses all of it. This is the defect class phase-051 names, but phase-051 names phase-022 specifically, and phase-022's work has since landed as 054e0d6 - so phase-051's finding no longer reproduces and this is the live instance.
```

**Re-verify this before you change anything.** If the finding no longer
reproduces on `main`, stop and write that to `FINDINGS.md` — a stale phase must
never be "fixed" by inventing a change.

## Goal

Get phase-041's implementation onto redblue main behind a commit its own REPORT describes, so the gate is green from history rather than from an uncommitted working tree.

## Method

1. Read `AGENTS.md` in full. Obey every hard rule; they are not negotiable.
2. Reproduce the finding. Record the exact command and the exact wrong output.
3. Write the failing test FIRST. Watch it fail. Do not touch production code
   until you have a red test that fails for the right reason.
4. Make the smallest change that turns it green.
5. Run the four gates yourself before claiming anything:

   ```bash
   cargo fmt --all -- --check
   cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
   cargo test --all-targets
   ./rbops/verify.sh phase-079
   ```

6. Write `REPORT.md` in the exact shape required by `AGENTS.md` section 4.

## Definition of done

- [ ] `git -C redblue status --porcelain` prints nothing for `src/` or `tests/text_split_join_test.rs`, and `git -C redblue log --oneline main --grep='phase-041 '` prints at least one line
- [ ] that commit's file list is compared BY NAME against the `What changed` table in phases/phase-041/REPORT.md - every file the table claims is in the commit and every file in the commit is in the table - and the comparison is asserted in the phase's own test, not left to review
- [ ] the phase asserts `git status --porcelain` is EMPTY before running `cargo test --test text_split_join_test`, so a green run from a dirty tree cannot satisfy this criterion
- [ ] the commit is single-parent on top of the previous main commit, and `git log --oneline main | grep -c checkpoint` is still 4 afterwards - this phase must not add checkpoint ancestry while fixing uncommitted work
- [ ] the committed tests are audited against the AGENTS.md 3.2 edge matrix and any uncovered row is added: at minimum `split` on empty text, `split` with a separator absent from the text, and `join` on an empty list, each asserted to a named value
- [ ] if the work cannot honestly be landed, `phases/phase-041/.done` is REMOVED and the phase ends with the phase re-runnable; it does not end with an uncommitted tree a second time
- [ ] `cargo test` reports 0 failures and `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean with no `allow(` added and no `#[ignore]`

## Constraints

- Do not touch `.github/workflows/`, `rbops/`, `.opencode/agent/`, or
  `rbops/phases.json`. The gate rejects these paths, and the bot token has no
  `workflows` scope so a push touching `.github/` is refused by GitHub.

- Do not change the language surface listed in `phases/INVARIANTS.md`.

## If you are blocked

Do not fake progress. Write what you tried, the exact error, and what you
believe is required into `FINDINGS.md`, then stop.

A blocked phase with an honest report is worth more than a green phase with a
lie in it. `verify.sh` will reject the phase anyway; a fabrication only adds a
blocking review finding on top.
